name: Ir-192
notes: Industrial gamma radiography source (URS RS-1). ENSDF (Baglin, NDS 113, 1871, 2012) via IAEA LiveChart / NNDC NuDat: beta- 95.24 % to Pt-192, EC 4.76 % to Os-192 (205.8, 484.6 keV). Nine lines >= 1 %, 2.14 gamma/decay; Pt/Os K X-rays (61-78 keV) omitted. Real cascades exist (e.g. 468 -> 316 keV) but cascadeCoincident is FALSE: in this study a cascade means every line in one decay, which is wrong for Ir-192, and its correlated emission is not modelled - no invented correlation.
